summary: Seven questions parents actually ask, each a tap to open, with a Register button at the top; the Little League jargon is gone. Why: shorter, and every link stays on our site.
blurb: The seven questions families ask, one tap each, with registration up top.
notes: Typos fixed earlier stay fixed (president@, not presdent@). The discount windows now appear as one line that points to the Registration page; dollar amounts live there only.

sources.fact: The Night Out with the Rainiers raffle raised enough to continue the scholarship program for the 2027 season.
Challenger Division is adaptive baseball for players with physical and intellectual challenges, ages 4 to 18 (up to 22 if still in school); questions to vpchallenger@blslittleleague.org.

Spring 2027 registration windows (board motion passed Nov 1): Black Friday sale Nov 27 to 29, $50 off per family; Early Bird Nov 30 to Dec 31, $25 off per family; full price from Jan 1, 2027. Minutes are up for board approval Dec 6.
Baseball league age is the player's age on Aug 31, 2027; softball league age is the age on Dec 31, 2026 (Little League age determination rule).

Evaluations, team notice dates, season dates, time commitment, scholarship application, the II(d) and school enrollment form note, the refund line and the carpool rule are the live FAQ's own wording, shortened.

long_summary: Title card with the one button (Spring 2027 registration, opens Nov 27; reads Register from the 27th), then 7 big tap rows: when can I register (with the Register button and the refund line once), which division (league age dates, a button to the new League Age page, the towns BLS serves, Challenger), evaluations, when you hear your team (with the carpool rule in one sentence), season and time commitment, help with the cost, where the fields are. Email card at the end. Cut from 19 questions: the 'Most asked' preview, the topic chips and seven sections, roster and manager policy (Coaches Corner), All Stars (Allstars page), volunteering (Volunteer page), the legacy 'late October' paragraph, the T-Mobile grant and every littleleague.org, littleleaguewa.org and wad10ll.org link.
